verdict.rationale: Fern documents automatic llms.txt generation for every docs site (fern-docs-7), and probes confirm it is live and functioning with actual AI-agent instructions (fern-probe-1, fern-probe-rt-2). The full-content Markdown variant (append .md/.mdx) is also documented (fern-docs-6) and verified working on at least one real page (fern-probe-rt-2), though a probe on a different page (/learn.md) returned 404 (fern-probe-2), showing the .md mirror isn't universal across all URL patterns. Missing for 10: consistent .md coverage across all page types/URLs and independent (non-Fern) confirmation that external agents actually discover/index via this mechanism.
